purpose: High-precision Store A -> Store B product matching criteria after per-attribute audit against the supplied datasets.

dataset_profile.important_asymmetry: Missing attributes are UNKNOWN, never mismatch evidence. Store B is much richer in descriptions/ingredients; Store A relies more heavily on titles/taxonomy/sizing.

principles: Automatic MATCH/NON_MATCH is preferred when evidence materially favors a side; REVIEW/GPT is reserved for a narrow uncertainty band. Hard vetoes remain authoritative.
Positive evidence and contradiction evidence run independently.
Missing data is unknown and never negative evidence.
Hard verified contradictions cannot be averaged away by fuzzy similarity, embeddings, or LLM judgment.
All comparators are category-gated; an attribute cannot fire outside its applicable product family.
Cross-brand equivalence is allowed only under BetterBasket private-label/fresh policy.
Confidence is calibrated on labeled pairs and candidate-set competition, not raw heuristic or LLM scores.

hard_veto_rules.name: canonical_category_conflict
hard_veto_rules.rule: Confident canonical product classes are incompatible.

hard_veto_rules.name: national_brand_conflict
hard_veto_rules.rule: Both sides are national brands and normalized primary brands differ without an approved alias/rebrand relation.

hard_veto_rules.name: cross_brand_type_illegal
hard_veto_rules.rule: Brands differ and pair is not permitted private-label/private-label or fresh/unbranded equivalence.

hard_veto_rules.name: functional_name_conflict
hard_veto_rules.rule: Functional product identities are materially different.

hard_veto_rules.name: model_part_conflict
hard_veto_rules.rule: Both sides expose reliable model/part identifiers and they differ.

hard_veto_rules.name: fixed_net_content_conflict
hard_veto_rules.rule: Normalized declared net content differs beyond unit conversion/rounding equivalence.

hard_veto_rules.name: pack_structure_conflict
hard_veto_rules.rule: Single/multipack or nested pack structure materially differs.

hard_veto_rules.name: physical_form_conflict
hard_veto_rules.rule: Liquid/powder/gel/tablet/aerosol/etc. differs when form defines use.

hard_veto_rules.name: flavor_scent_variant_conflict
hard_veto_rules.rule: Explicit flavor or scent variants are incompatible.

hard_veto_rules.name: diet_variant_conflict
hard_veto_rules.rule: Explicit organic/gluten/sugar/sodium/fat/lactose/vegan/non-GMO variant claims conflict when identity-bearing.

hard_veto_rules.name: meat_species_cut_conflict
hard_veto_rules.rule: Meat species or primary cut differs.

hard_veto_rules.name: egg_size_grade_conflict
hard_veto_rules.rule: Explicit shell-egg size or grade differs.

hard_veto_rules.name: egg_production_conflict
hard_veto_rules.rule: Explicit cage-free/free-range/pasture-raised method differs when marketed as variant.

hard_veto_rules.name: juice_percentage_conflict
hard_veto_rules.rule: 100% juice vs drink/cocktail or materially different declared juice percentage.

hard_veto_rules.name: alcohol_strength_conflict
hard_veto_rules.rule: Normalized ABV materially differs for otherwise same alcohol product.

hard_veto_rules.name: vintage_appellation_conflict
hard_veto_rules.rule: Vintage/appellation differs when declared and identity-bearing.

hard_veto_rules.name: spf_conflict
hard_veto_rules.rule: SPF differs when defining sunscreen/cosmetic variant.

hard_veto_rules.name: hair_skin_target_conflict
hard_veto_rules.rule: Explicit target hair/skin type differs when defining variant.

hard_veto_rules.name: paper_ply_conflict
hard_veto_rules.rule: Explicit ply count differs for comparable paper goods.

hard_veto_rules.name: rated_use_count_conflict
hard_veto_rules.rule: Declared loads/washes/uses differ when that count defines the marketed SKU.

hard_veto_rules.name: dimension_conflict
hard_veto_rules.rule: Declared product dimensions differ where dimensions define the consumer variant.

hard_veto_rules.name: theme_franchise_conflict
hard_veto_rules.rule: Explicit franchise/theme differs when it defines the item.

hard_veto_rules.name: occasion_conflict
hard_veto_rules.rule: Explicit holiday/occasion differs when it defines the item.

hard_veto_rules.name: candidate_nonuniqueness
hard_veto_rules.rule: Top candidate is not decisively separated from another plausible candidate; forces ABSTAIN.

hard_veto_rules.name: washable_waterproof_variant_conflict
hard_veto_rules.rule: Explicit washable versus waterproof conflict when it defines the eye-makeup/mascara variant.

hard_veto_rules.name: protein_source_conflict
hard_veto_rules.rule: Explicit incompatible protein sources or animal-vs-plant formulation in a protein-centric product are incompatible.

hard_veto_rules.name: coffee_format_conflict
hard_veto_rules.rule: Explicit incompatible coffee delivery formats such as ground/whole-bean/instant versus pods or capsules are not the same SKU.

combination_policy.raw_pairwise_space: All unordered pairs of the 420 atomic criteria = 87,990.
combination_policy.important: This is a representational search space, not a mandate to evaluate every pair for every candidate.
combination_policy.anti_double_counting: Merged legacy attributes must share one evidence channel; correlated raw fields may not independently inflate confidence.

research_basis: BetterBasket assessment: exact identity vs consumer-equivalent private-label/fresh matching.
GS1 Global Data Model: product description includes Brand, Sub-Brand, Functional Name, Variant and Net Content.
GS1 GTIN Management: formulation/functionality, declared net content, primary brand, pack quantity, assortment and selected variant changes are product-identity relevant.
GS1 fresh-food guidance: fixed- vs variable-measure items require different quantity treatment.
FDA generic-drug identity concepts: active ingredient, strength, dosage form and route are core equivalence dimensions.
